subtasks.title: Add slugify and its public export
subtasks.goal:
Implement the utility using named ESM exports and the existing semicolon-free source style.
Absent src/slug.mjs → create exported function slugify(text): lowercase with toLowerCase(), trim(), replace /[^a-z0-9]+/g with '-', then remove boundary hyphens with /^-+|-+$/g; return the resulting string.
src/index.mjs version-only export → retain export const version = 1 and append export { slugify } from './slug.mjs'.
Keep test/slug.test.mjs and package.json unchanged; no existing code is removed.
